assumptions: Recovery starts when the incident is declared (T+0). Detection, triage, forensic hold and decision time are not included in estimates.
The parallel estimate assumes unlimited restore capacity, so independent assets restore simultaneously; the serial estimate assumes one asset at a time. Reality lies between the two.
Restore durations come from the most recent passing restore test where one was measured; otherwise the documented estimate is used. Unknown durations are not guessed.
An asset may start restoring only after every prerequisite in the plan has finished.
Assets outside the plan scope are assumed to remain operational.
